title: 船舶壓艙水管理系統
summary: 分開壓艙功能與水處理效果，以水量、停留時間、濃度和抽樣證據建立處理流程模型。 在壓艙水流程與水質資料室依十個單元完成機制觀察、定量比較、量測驗證與故障診斷；各算例為獨立教學假設，完整保留資料來源與模型限制。
summaryEn: Separate ballasting function from treatment performance using water, time, concentration and sampling evidence. Complete ten units of mechanisms, quantitative comparisons, measurement verification and diagnosis in the Ballast-water process and quality-data laboratory. Examples are independent teaching assumptions with sources and model limitations retained.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創船舶海洋教學。數值均為明示假設，不是同名船舶的實測規格、法規認證或實船操作參數。以虛構資料、教學模型與常壓桌面練習學習，排除武器、戰術與載人下潛操作。
scopeEn: Original marine teaching based on public principles. All numbers are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vessel specifications, certification criteria or real-ship operating parameters. Learning uses synthetic data, teaching models and unpressurized desktop exercises, excluding weapons, tactics and crewed diving operations.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 壓艙質量與浮力帳：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Ballast mass and buoyancy accounting: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 壓艙質量與浮力帳 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Ballast mass and buoyancy accounting and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在「船舶壓艙水管理系統」的「壓艙質量與浮力帳」中，靜水浮力等於排開水的重量；平衡時排水質量等於總質量。 本單元須將作用機制畫成有輸入、輸出與邊界的圖，並核對是否符合本課問題：分開壓艙功能與水處理效果，以水量、停留時間、濃度和抽樣證據建立處理流程模型。
steps.instructionEn: Within Ballast-water management systems, Ballast mass and buoyancy accounting examines this mechanism: Static buoyancy equals displaced-water weight; equilibrium displacement mass equals total mass. Draw inputs, outputs and boundaries, then relate it to the course question: Separate ballasting function from treatment performance using water, time, concentration and sampling evidence.
steps.observation: 本單元為獨立假想教學台架，不可將不同單元數值拼成真實船舶規格。輸入：ρ=1025 kg/m³，排水體積 V=18 m³。關係式 M=ρV；含單位換算算式 1025*18 = 18450 kg。適用條件：只代表靜水質量平衡，未驗證傾覆、波浪與艙口進水。
steps.observationEn: This unit is an independent hypothetical teaching bench; values from different units must not be combined into vessel specifications. Inputs: Density 1025 kg/m³ and displaced volume 18 m³. Relation M=ρV; expression including unit conversion 1025*18 = 18450 kg. Applicability: Static mass balance only; capsize, waves and downflooding remain unverified.
steps.failure: 本單元先檢查以下替代原因：不同密度下仍假設相同載重和相同吃水，會讓質量與體積帳互相矛盾。 比較它和輸入真正變動時會出現的觀察差別。
steps.failureEn: First examine this alternative cause: Assuming equal load and equal draft at different densities makes mass and volume accounting inconsistent. Compare its observable pattern with a genuine change in the input.
steps.check: 對「壓艙質量與浮力帳」，分別以體積積分與質量清單重算，對照兩者差額。 保存原始觀察和推導，不以師傅輔助完成標記代替證據。
steps.checkEn: For Ballast mass and buoyancy accounting, Recalculate from volume integration and a mass inventory, then compare their difference. Retain raw observations and derivation; an assisted-completion marker does not replace evidence.

steps.titleEn: Stability effect of partial filling: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 部分充填的穩度影響 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Stability effect of partial filling and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在「船舶壓艙水管理系統」的「部分充填的穩度影響」中，艙內液面橫向移動使有效重心升高，削弱初穩度。 本單元須將作用機制畫成有輸入、輸出與邊界的圖，並核對是否符合本課問題：分開壓艙功能與水處理效果，以水量、停留時間、濃度和抽樣證據建立處理流程模型。
steps.instructionEn: Within Ballast-water management systems, Stability effect of partial filling examines this mechanism: Transverse liquid movement raises effective center of gravity and reduces initial stability. Draw inputs, outputs and boundaries, then relate it to the course question: Separate ballasting function from treatment performance using water, time, concentration and sampling evidence.
steps.observation: 本單元為獨立假想教學台架，不可將不同單元數值拼成真實船舶規格。輸入：ρliquid=1000 kg/m³，I=8 m⁴，m=20000 kg。關係式 FSC=ρliquid I/m；含單位換算算式 1000*8/20000 = 0.4 m。適用條件：假設自由液面未受隔艙及大角度幾何限制。
steps.observationEn: This unit is an independent hypothetical teaching bench; values from different units must not be combined into vessel specifications. Inputs: Liquid density 1000 kg/m³, surface inertia 8 m⁴ and displacement mass 20000 kg. Relation FSC=ρliquid I/m; expression including unit conversion 1000*8/20000 = 0.4 m. Applicability: Assumes a free surface without compartment or large-angle geometric constraints.
steps.failure: 本單元先檢查以下替代原因：用液量比例直接縮放自由液面二次矩會忽略形狀。 比較它和輸入真正變動時會出現的觀察差別。
steps.failureEn: First examine this alternative cause: Scaling surface inertia only by fill fraction ignores geometry. Compare its observable pattern with a genuine change in the input.
steps.check: 對「部分充填的穩度影響」，分開比較空艙、部分充填和滿艙，保持總質量帳一致。 保存原始觀察和推導，不以師傅輔助完成標記代替證據。
steps.checkEn: For Stability effect of partial filling, Compare empty, partly filled and full tanks while reconciling total mass. Retain raw observations and derivation; an assisted-completion marker does not replace evidence.
